description: Clipping campaigns that pay for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels clips of streams in any category (gaming and streamer campaigns by default; GTA 6, the first featured category, with filter gta; music, entertainment and Just Chatting streamers with their own filters; every campaign with filter all), ranked by what a typical approved clip has actually earned. Covers Content Rewards, Ssemble, Vyro and Clipstake; each row names its marketplace (join_on). Each has its rate in $ per 1K views (or per post), cap per clip, budget left and days of budget left (null = that marketplace does not publish it). Answers 'which clipping campaign pays most', 'best GTA 6 clipping campaigns right now', 'how much do clippers get per 1,000 views', 'where can I get paid to clip'. Refreshed every 30 minutes. Works in any language.

filter.description: gta = GTA campaigns only; gaming = gaming and streamer campaigns (default); music = campaigns that pay for clips playing their song; entertainment = shows, podcasts, creators and events; just_chatting = streamers paying for clips of their own streams, not tied to a game; all = every campaign

platform.description: Only campaigns that pay on this platform
